correctness.rationale: Set z=ay/S; since z rational and z²=x^(2n)-c^(2n) is integral, z is integral. Factor (x^n-z)(x^n+z)=c^(2n) and recover every signed divisor pair with parity, integral-power and a|Sz filters. For t=1 the other auxiliary equation w²-v²=N>0 factors into divisors and is finite; N=3 has exactly four ordered signed solutions (±2,±1). Witness (a,b,c,n,x,y)=(1,1,3,1,5,4). Independently compared divisor enumeration and direct integer equation in 36 small parameter cases; algebra proves all parameters.
